SELECT city_id, address_count, address_count / average_addresses_per_city AS relative_to_average, address_count / total_addresses AS share_of_all_addresses
FROM (
  SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count,
         (SELECT AVG(city_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS city_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id) AS city_counts) AS average_addresses_per_city,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) AS total_addresses
  FROM address
  GROUP BY city_id
) AS city_address_counts
ORDER BY share_of_all_addresses DESC
LIMIT 10
